duration.text: The Road and Railway Engineering at Changsha University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 972 USD/per year ￥ 7000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1)A valid ordinary passport (valid for more than one year; applicants in China must also submit a valid residence permit page).(2)Notarized highest academic degree certificate (scanned original and translation).If the applicant is currently a student, a Certificate of Enrollment issued by the school specifying the expected graduation date must be submitted.Certificates obtained overseas must be notarized; certificates obtained within China require only a scanned copy.(3)Scanned copies of transcripts from the previous academic stage and their translations.(4)Study and Research Plan for master’s applicants (at least 1,000 words), including: Introduction, Research Questions, Literature Review, Research Methods, Expected Conclusions, and References.(5)Two academic recommendation letters from professors or associate professors for master’s applicants (written in Chinese or English).(6)Foreigner Physical Examination Form (fully completed and valid within 6 months) (Blank form attached as Annex ).(7)Valid Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority (normally within 6 months prior to the application submission date).(8)Language proficiency certificates:Chinese-taught programs: HSK certificate.English-taught programs: TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo certificates (Exemptions apply as noted above).(9)Academic achievements, cultural and sports competition certificates (if available).

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens.2.Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy, and possess good conduct and academic performance.3.Academic and age requirements:For undergraduate applicants: Must hold a high school diploma and be under 25 years of age.For master’s degree applicants: Must hold a bachelor’s degree and be under 35 years of age.Applicants under the age of 18 must submit a notarized letter of guardianship in China.4.Language proficiency requirements:Program Language RequirementsUndergraduate: Transportation Engineering (Chinese-taught) Generally, HSK Level 3 or above. Those who have not achieved 180 points or above in HSK Level 4 must undertake one year of preparatory study after enrollment.Master’s: Road and Railway Engineering (English-taught) TOEFL score of 68 or above, IELTS score of 5.5 or above, or Duolingo score of 85 or above.Applicants from English-speaking countries or those whose previous degree programs were taught in English are exempt from providing English proficiency certificates.
